conflicts.permit: By continuing we assume you accept the use of cookies.
conflicts.prohibit: Most Internet browsers automatically accept cookies. If you do not want cookies from This-App or other websites, you can instruct your browser, by changing its settings, to stop accepting cookies or to prompt you before accepting a cookie from the websites you visit.
conflicts.situation: A user continues browsing the website after configuring their browser settings to refuse or reject all cookies.
conflicts.reason: One provision deems continuing browsing as acceptance of cookies, while another permits users to reject cookies via browser settings while continuing to visit.
